research_question: Does longer broadband outage duration reduce invented small-firm export sales in the fictional province of Nullmark?
data_description: Cross-section of 800 invented firms. Variables: firm_id, outage_hours, export_sales (log), distance_to_relay_tower (km), sector.
institutional_context: Outage duration in this fictional province is driven by distance to a relay tower that was sited in 2040 for unrelated geological reasons.
